gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
Sales figures have tailed ___ since the summer.
He stole the pens and got away ___ it.
gaps.explanation: get away with something = do wrong without being punished.

gaps.sentence: She waited at the restaurant for an hour, but he had stood her ___ again.
gaps.explanation: 'Stand somebody up' = fail to keep an arranged meeting.

gaps.sentence: Please fill ___ this form and sign at the bottom.
gaps.explanation: fill in/out a form (British prefers in).
